subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Home become the sole supported Wear surface for agent and session switching, replacing the dedicated Agent and Session pages while model selection is capability-gated during paired-device upgrades?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded and has proof, but it deliberately changes the Wear information architecture and the supported upgrade experience rather than repairing an established broken contract.

options.title: Adopt the Home-first workflow
options.body: Accept the three-page navigation model and capability-gated model controls as the supported Wear UX, with the documented older-Phone disabled state during mixed-version pairing.

options.title: Retain dedicated context pages
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps Agent and Session pages as an alternative navigation path while Home offers compact shortcuts.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the three-page navigation model and capability-gated model controls as the supported Wear UX, with the documented older-Phone disabled state during mixed-version pairing.
